name: Quaker Quick Grits (Smooth White Hominy)
whyItWorks: Made from dried white corn that has been nixtamalized to completely shed the tough outer kernel hull before being ground into fine hominy grits. Creamy, comforting, and 100% free of sharp corn skins.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil 1/4 cup grits in 1 cup salted water for 5 minutes until thick. Stir in 1 tsp butter or ghee.
